title.zh: 将新比斯开省Kasibu市镇Pudi描笼涯由技术教育与技能发展署（TESDA）管理的Kasibu国立农业学校更名为新比斯开理工学院的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Kasibu National Agricultural School Being Administered By the Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (TESDA) in Barangay Pudi, Municipality of Kasibu, Province of Nueva Vizcaya to Nueva Vizcaya Polytechnic Institute
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Kasibu National Agricultural School Being Administered By the Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (TESDA) in Barangay Pudi, Municipality of Kasibu, Province of Nueva Vizcaya to Nueva Vizcaya Polytechnic Institute
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Cơ quan Kasibu National Agricultural School Being Administered By the Technical Education and Skills Development tại Barangay Pudi, Đô thị Kasibu, Tỉnh Nueva Vizcaya thành Học viện Nueva Vizcaya Polytechnic
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อองค์กร Kasibu National Agricultural School Being Administered By the Technical Education and Skills Development ในบารังไกย์ Pudi เทศบาล Kasibu จังหวัด Nueva Vizcaya เป็น สถาบัน Nueva Vizcaya Polytechnic
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Otoritas Kasibu National Agricultural School Being Administered By the Technical Education and Skills Development di Barangay Pudi, Kotamadya Kasibu, Provinsi Nueva Vizcaya menjadi Institut Nueva Vizcaya Polytechnic
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Pihak Berkuasa Kasibu National Agricultural School Being Administered By the Technical Education and Skills Development di Barangay Pudi, Perbandaran Kasibu, Wilayah Nueva Vizcaya kepada Institut Nueva Vizcaya Polytechnic

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2016/ra_10823_2016.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Kasibu National Agricultural School being administered by the Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (TESDA) in Barangay Pudi, Municipality of Kasibu, Province of Nueva Vizcaya is hereby changed to Nueva Vizcaya Polytechnic Institute.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
